audience: farmers and ranchers who track livestock, crops and sales in Farmbrite

useCases.title: Review animals with their measurements and treatments
useCases.text: The AI lists animals by status and opens one with its location and custom fields. It reads weight, temperature and condition score records and treatment records.

useCases.title: Check grazing status of fields and pastures
useCases.text: The AI reads, per field or pasture, the animals present, days rested, rest days required and the last grazing date, so you see which fields are ready.

useCases.title: Check inventory and where it is stored
useCases.text: The AI lists inventory items with quantity remaining, value and low-stock alert level, and reads the warehouse and bin where one item is stored.

useCases.title: Log a feeding, measurement, treatment or harvest
useCases.text: The AI records a feeding for an animal or group (it can draw the feed from inventory), a measurement, a treatment such as a vaccine or dewormer, or a harvest.

useCases.title: Create or update farm tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks with status, priority and due date, creates a task linked to an animal, field or crop, or changes a task and marks it done.

useCases.title: Review, create or update sales orders
useCases.text: The AI lists sales orders with status and payment status, opens one with its line items, creates an order, or changes an order's status or payment status.
